text:
ash: Morning quickchain — short check: where are we on the model onboarding for tiny-q-13b and the eval regressions? post any blockers or CR pings here :eyes:

lina: artifact uploaded to staging last night. full eval finished but there are a few regressions on the promptset from the billing flow tests.

maria: saw the failures, looks like hallucination rate up on edge-case entity extraction. I have a failing example, will paste below.

maria: ```
input: "Charge failed for invoice #INV-4829, customer name missing; what went wrong?"
expected: extract {invoice_id: "INV-4829", action: "escalate_to_billing"}
model: returns long paraphrase, misses invoice id
```

jonathan: thanks — I can reproduce locally with the quantized artifact. suspect KV cache alignment after our custom attention patch. running a KV warmup unit to confirm.

sam: quick heads-up, I left an inline CR on the model-serving PR (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/model-serving/pulls/342). the batching code needs an edge-case check when seq_len==1.

ash: @sam saw the CR, assigning to @jonathan for follow-up. if it's a trivial guard, please patch and re-run smoke.

jonathan: taking it. also trying a targeted eval that zeros prefix cache to see if behavior changes. my hypothesis: quantization + new attention kernel causes off-by-one in cached keys.

qa-bot: automated-evals finished: regressions: 6 tests failed out of 1,200 (0.5%). failing suites: billing-flow, account-summary. detailed report uploaded to /reports/2100001234-eval.json

lina: I ran a quick manual A/B with the previous release and the new tiny-q-13b: latency is fine but quality delta on extraction prompts is visible. attaching a short diff of outputs in the report.

maria: if we need a rollback plan, we should stage a canary with fallback to the previous model for the billing route only. I can add a route-level policy in console.

ash: good idea. @lina can you prep a canary config? set traffic to 10% and fallback to v1 if >2% regression in 10m window.

lina: on it. will push the canary and schedule a 30m watch.

jonathan: patched the guard on batching and re-ran the failing sample locally — still failing, so batching guard wasn't the root. KV warmup run: starting now.

dev-bot: deploy check started for tiny-q-13b artifact 2100001229 -> staging (sha: d4c3f2). status: running smoke tests.

maria: when jonathan has KV results, can you drop the failing sample into the eval harness so QA can confirm? i'll triage the types of hallucination.

jonathan: KV warmup shows misaligned key offsets in transformer layer 18 with seq padded to 2. reproducer below:

jonathan: ```bash
python -m evals.run --model ./artifacts/tiny-q-13b --prompt-file tests/billing_prompts.json --seed 42 --kv-warmup True
```

sam: thanks. i can add an offset-correction shim to try on staging without touching kernels — quick patch to runtime. want me to push that to a feature branch?

ash: please do. label it quickfix/kv-offset and link the PR here. we'll gate it behind the canary.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/889 — includes a shim and an opt-in flag KV_OFFSET_FIX.

lina: deployed canary with 10% traffic for billing-route, fallback policy in place. monitoring dashboards pinned to the thread.

qa-bot: smoke-run result: 1 warning, 0 critical. snapshot saved: s3://redwood-evals/snapshots/2100001234-canary.json

maria: running manual checks against canary snapshot — will post differences in 15m.

jonathan: KV_OFFSET_FIX applied in a dev branch on staging runtime; running targeted eval now.

ash: thanks team. quick todo list:
- jonathan: finish targeted eval + paste results here (ETA 20m)
- sam: keep PR open, add a small unit test for seq_len==1 case (ETA today)
- lina: monitor canary, revert rule if regression >2% (ETA watch 30m)
- maria: collect failure samples and add to hotlist (ETA 15m)

lina: noted. ping me if you want me to temporarily disable streaming to reduce noise.

jonathan: eval done — with KV_OFFSET_FIX enabled the failing sample now extracts invoice id correctly. metrics: billing-flow failure rate dropped from 0.6% -> 0.08% in the targeted set.

maria: awesome, will rerun full suite after we merge the shim. i'll update the hotlist and add a short note for the docs team about the subtle quantization caveat.

ash: great progress. if CI is green on sam's PR and jonathan's evals look stable, we'll promote to staging main and schedule a limited production rollout tomorrow.

ash: otherwise, keep updates here — short replies only so we can scan. :thumbsup:
